summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a Material Fact to Chile's CMF (the local securities regulator, equivalent to an SEC current report). On September 10, 2026, the Bank placed dematerialized bearer bonds in the local market under its registered credit line No. 20220013 dated November 15, 2022. Series AA-14 bonds, ticker BSTD141223, totaled 293,000 UF, maturing December 1, 2028, at an average placement rate of 2.10%. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation; no price-per-share, premium, or deal terms apply.
